first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the completion decline and may also recover activation without introducing discount-driven revenue-quality risk. Verify memory_86 because its reported gains stop at early adoption, leaving long-term qualified revenue uncertain; verify memory_73 because promotional pricing is the strongest competing response, but its sustainability, retention, and customer-quality effects are not stated.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying and shortening onboarding. The verified source showed +13% completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and +3% 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable value. Promotional pricing is rejected because its +18% qualified-revenue lift came with 12% lower 30-day retention and failure through first renewal. Longer-term revenue impact beyond 30-day retention remains uncertain, so avoid a broad rollout until cohort quality is measured.
